name: Prepared Vegetables
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 1, friturier 1, grillardin 1, line cook 1, rotisseur 1

Flavor Profiles bitter, salty, sour, spicy, or texture
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1d4

DESCRIPTION

A well-seasoned variety of prepared vegetables can be boiled, baked, fried, or roasted. Each serving counts as 1 good meal. After eating prepared vegetables at least once per day, a creature can gain the full benefits of resting for 8 hours after only 6 hours have passed. If it does rest for 8 or more hours, the creature regains 1 additional hit point per level, 1 additional point of ability damage is removed, and exhaustion goes away entirely (rather than only being reduced to fatigue). Creatures that gain the benefits of rest after a shorter time than 6 hours use the 8-hour benefit above after resting for their normal amount of time, but that time is not reduced further.

Additional salty or sour ingredients increase the duration to 1 day/level.

Additional sweet ingredients increase the serving size by +2.
